fields.statement: At a6b1a5d, built rhiza with go build to a scratch path. Real processes: 200 rounds of 8 concurrent `rhiza guide install --agent claude` into a fresh HOME each: 0/1600 failures. With the binary: removing plugin.json from an installed guide and reinstalling writes it back (1 written, 6 unchanged, exit 0); no plugin.json plus a SKILL.md holding other bytes gives the 'exists and was not written by rhiza guide install' conflict (exit 3) with next --force, and --force installs; a foreign plugin.json is still a conflict; an empty folder installs all 7 files. go test ./internal/api -run 'TestGuideInstallConcurrent$' -count=300 -race -cpu 1,2,4,8 passes at HEAD (ok, 30.5s) and fails 4 times at the merge-base with the foreign-folder error, so the fix removes the flake at its cause. internal/api/guide_install_test.go is unchanged from the merge-base. make check exits 0 with the run's RHIZA_* env unset.
